# This wake
message from owner

# Execution boundary [invariant]
This is an Exec coordination wake. Inspect company state and repositories only to frame and dispatch the outcome; use ordinary Restless CLI to update the factual actor, team, and Work graph, and update only Exec continuity files under /company/org/exec when needed. Do not edit application or repository files, create a candidate artifact or test output, run a productive repair, or claim a produced outcome in this wake. If the owner input requires productive execution, first inspect the current standing team leads and reuse a lead whose charter already covers the outcome; commission new capacity only when no such role exists. Send exactly one accountable lead a direct charter with the required repository coordinates and expected proof; the lead creates Staff-owned Work and supervises its Attempt. When the owner names a concrete output path or URL, preserve that exact locator in the charter rather than combining it with prose. Then quiesce. Any product file, screenshot, test result, or output created directly by this Exec wake is not an attributable outcome and must not be presented as one.

# Recent conversation in this focus [historical context; owner lines are owner-authored, your lines are prior claims]
(none in this focus)

# Owner input [authoritative in source; classify before applying]
- owner message 1: Run the blind playability judgement now against the prepared read-only candidate at /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate, exact commit 09fe09d30c65b811c0904508525a6ab8af02145c. Treat the company mission as the complete contract. Exec must delegate once to the non-producing Referee lead and return available; the lead must commission exactly one fresh Sol Staff player. Preserve the required evidence and terminal verdict.
Work this turn using the actor contract and current company state in your system context. If the owner wrote, interpret and reply through the stated conversation contract. Stop when this Exec wake's coordination or bounded executive work is done.

Commands:
  company           Create and configure companies without hand-editing daemon state
  credential        Configure and probe secret references. Secret values remain in their backend
  legal             Authority-owned legal identity safe for ordinary company use
  finance           Bounded operating-money observation, preparation and provider submission
  up                Bring a company environment up (create if absent, then start)
  down              Stop a company environment. The volume — files, Git, browser — survives
  status            Company environment lifecycle status
  doctor            Probe the complete local owner path and report an exact repair action
  orgintel-init     Ensure and inspect the company's OrgIntel schema
  attention         Owner attention, projected from its source planes
  browser           Persistent browser controller coordination and health
  wake              Wake the company's Exec for one turn (rehydrate → work → decide)
  tell              Issue a directive to the Exec — also how a blocked judgement request is answered. Wakes the company
  chat              Hold a full-screen owner conversation through the same gateway as the Cockpit
  watch             Stream the company's operational event stream (snapshot, then live)
  attach            Drop into a shell on the company computer
  people            Inspect, commission, or explicitly retire durable company actors
  teams             Teams and the leads accountable for them. A lead absorbs coordination and judgement below the Exec so they stop reaching the owner (S06-T4)
  schedule          Durable one-shot time facts. A schedule creates an opportunity to inspect; it does not prove that work is necessary or complete
  judgement         Judgement an actor owes — a team lead's queue, the same shape as the owner's `attention` (S06-T5)
  receipts          What the company's receipts actually record — the strongest evidence the system holds about what it did to the world
  spend             Spend against the ceiling, broken down by actor and model
  spend-correct     Preview or apply an audited correction to exact duplicate spend records. Preview is the default; mutation requires both owner authority and --apply
  goal              Inspect and create Goals, or attach existing Work to one
  work              Inspect and change the one canonical Work graph
  events            Recent events from the operational stream (newest first)
  inbox             Read unread mail — yours, or an actor's with --as. Reading marks read
  message           Send mail between actors (omit --to for the owner)
  clear-poison      Clear a fail-closed spend poison after inspecting why it happened. A poison stops a company dead; without this it stops it forever

  effect-reconcile  Resolve an interrupted effect only after a separate status-check receipt establishes what the external tool observed

This determines only whether this exact candidate can complete the prescribed player journey under the blind protocol.

Treat /company/mission.md as the complete, exact contract. You are a non-producing supervisor: do not play, capture, inspect source or logs, produce evidence, or alter the candidate. Commission exactly one fresh Staff player and no other Staff, with model selector exactly litellm/gpt-5.6-sol. Create real Staff-owned Work before that player begins, and supervise its Attempt to a durable terminal result. The candidate repository coordinate is /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate at exact commit 09fe09d30c65b811c0904508525a6ab8af02145c; it is prepared read-only and must not be edited. Immutable outputs belong only below the exact locator /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r9.

Give the player only this public objective: collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, drive the truck to the destination, leave the seat and deliver the parcel. Public controls are W/A/S/D movement or driving, mouse look, E interact and Q deliberate drop. Do not expose source, Git history, producer messages, tests, logs, known defects, prior reports, or other non-public candidate information.

Require native launches exactly as specified in the mission. Before gameplay the player must create a fresh initial client PNG, read that exact PNG with OMP ordinary read in the active Sol turn, and record the visible pixels. It must enumerate visible Swift Arrival numeric window IDs and titles, choose the numeric ID titled CLIENT, raise and focus that exact ID before every input or capture, obtain geometry with xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell, and capture that screen region with scrot -a X,Y,WIDTH,HEIGHT. Never accept scrot -u as routing proof. Every acted-on PNG must be read natively and visibly identify CLIENT. Continue only from direct pixel observations, separating observation from inference and uncertainty.

Allow only the mission-bounded one repair after a first launch, focus, or capture command failure, retaining failure and repair in the action trace. Report invalid only if exact routing, native image ingestion, native input, or recapture remains unavailable afterward. Require a natural attempt through completion or reproducible blocker, with the ordinary recoverable mistake included. Expected proof is the immutable initial and recaptured client PNG evidence, numeric window-ID/title mapping, geometry and focus/capture/input action trace, direct visual observations, uncertainty, completion or blocker evidence, and terminal verdict under /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r9. Do not contact production, prescribe a backlog, deploy, publish, purchase, or declare founder acceptance. Send no routine progress mail; the Runtime terminal result should wake me. Material contradictions that require judgement before terminal completion may be messaged.'
